items.reply: Aap ki payment verification process me ho sakti hai. Kripya thora wait karein. Payment approve hote hi wallet balance automatically update ho jayega. Agar zyada time ho gaya hai to payment screenshot aur transaction ID share karein.
Agar aap ne raat 11:00 PM ke baad payment bheji hai to verification next morning ki jati hai. Aksar payment subah 7:00 AM se pehle approve ho jati hai. Kripya thora intezar karein.
Filhal hum Easypaisa aur Binance accept karte hain. Aap kisi bhi personal account se payment bhej sakte hain.
Payment verify karne ke liye payment screenshot aur transaction ID zaroor upload karein.
Agar galat amount bhej di hai to payment screenshot aur transaction ID share karein. Hamari support team case review karegi.
Agar payment do martaba send ho gayi hai to dono transaction IDs aur screenshots share karein taake verification ki ja sake.
Agar payment reject ya cancel hui hai to screenshot aur transaction ID share karein. Hum aap ka case check karenge.
Aap Dashboard me Payment History section se apni tamam payments dekh sakte hain.
Agar payment verify nahi hui to transaction ID aur payment screenshot bhej dein.
Agar AI database se connected hai to real wallet balance show kare. Warna customer ko Dashboard me Wallet section check karne ka mashwara dein.
Payment verification normally jaldi complete ho jati hai. Agar payment raat 11 PM ke baad bheji gayi ho to subah verify ki jati hai.
Hamari payments manual verification ke baad approve hoti hain. Kripya verification complete hone ka intezar karein.
Ji haan. Aap kisi bhi personal account se Easypaisa ya Binance ke zariye payment bhej sakte hain.
Payment verify karne ke liye screenshot aur transaction ID zaroori hai. Agar upload nahi ki to verification delay ho sakti hai.
